visual.general_description: Single axial chest CT slice with a large lung mass marked by a red arrow.
visual.detailed_description: Axial chest CT in lung window with the patient supine (spine at the bottom). A large, rounded, homogeneous soft-tissue-density mass occupies much of the image-left hemithorax anteriorly and laterally, abutting the chest wall and the mediastinum; a rim of ground-glass or hazy density lies along its upper-lateral margin. A red arrow outside the lung at the upper left points to the upper-lateral edge of the mass. The heart and great vessels are central, the spine and descending aorta lie posteriorly, and the contralateral lung on the image right is aerated with normal vessels. No text, laterality marker, scale bar or patient identifier is visible. The image left corresponds to the patient right by the usual radiologic convention, but no side marker is printed.
